movies.overview: After his billionaire industrialist boss is murdered in front of him, Cole Reed is set up to take the fall for the crime -- leaving him on the run as he works to uncover an international conspiracy.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.overview: The Platt family bands together to navigate their new surroundings after a cosmic event transports their suburban neighborhood to someplace unknown.

movies.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movies.overview: A director making a slasher sequel becomes obsessed with casting the original film's 'final girl,' leading both women into psychological and sexual chaos.

movies.title: One Night Only
movies.overview: Two New Yorkers search for love on the one night of the year when pre-marital sex is legal.

shows.title: Lanterns
shows.overview: Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

shows.title: The Shards
shows.overview: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

shows.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
shows.overview: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom, from The Big Bang Theory (2007), returns in a new series where he attempts—and apparently fails—to save the universe, staying true to his unlucky nature.

shows.title: Lucky
shows.overview: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

shows.title: Ann Droid
shows.overview: Ann, an advanced AI, grapples with human emotions while discovering dark secrets within the corporation that created her.

anime.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
anime.overview: Once the Demon King, now a shut-in NEET—Ryuusei Narukami’s second life is anything but peaceful! When Meteor Hanaori, the Hero who once defeated him, suddenly returns as a normal high school girl, his world is thrown into chaos.…
